Steamed now runs on **Minecraft 1.21.1** as well as 26.2.

### New

- **Minecraft 1.21.1** (and 1.21), on Fabric and NeoForge. Hosting, the lobby screen, invites, the friends' lobbies
  list and the title-screen and pause-menu buttons all work the same as on 26.2
- One jar per Minecraft version and loader, named like `steamed-fabric-0.2.0+1.21.1.jar`. Pick the one that matches
  your game:

| Jar | Minecraft | Also needs |
|---|---|---|
| `steamed-fabric-0.2.0+26.2.jar` | 26.2 | Fabric API, Fabric Language Kotlin |
| `steamed-neoforge-0.2.0+26.2.jar` | 26.2 | Kotlin for Forge 6.4+ |
| `steamed-quilt-0.2.0+26.2.jar` | 26.2 | Fabric API, Fabric Language Kotlin |
| `steamed-fabric-0.2.0+1.21.1.jar` | 1.21, 1.21.1 | Fabric API, Fabric Language Kotlin |
| `steamed-neoforge-0.2.0+1.21.1.jar` | 1.21.1 | Kotlin for Forge 5.12+ |

### Changes

- The invite screen draws each friend's face next to their name instead of inside it
- Behind the scenes, every version and loader is now built from one source tree, so later backports are much cheaper

### Good to know

- 1.21.1 and 26.2 players can't join each other. The friends' lobbies list greys out a lobby from a different
  Minecraft version and says why
- Not on 1.21.1: Quilt, and player heads inside chat lines (join and leave lines still get the orange diamond)
- Verified on 1.21.1 so far: loading, connecting to Steam, the title screen and joining a world, on both loaders.
  Joining a friend, kicking, voice chat and web maps across two Steam accounts haven't been tested on 1.21.1 yet
- Everyone in a lobby still needs the same Steamed version, so update together with your friends
